privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Information on the processing of your data in accordance with GDPR

overview.title: Privacy at a Glance
overview.content: The following information provides a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data that can be used to personally identify you.

general.title: General Information
general.content1: The operators of these pages take the protection of your personal data very seriously. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with the legal data protection regulations as well as this privacy policy.
general.content2: When you use this website, various personal data is collected. This privacy policy explains what data we collect and what we use it for.

responsible.title: Responsible Party
responsible.intro: The party responsible for data processing on this website is:

collection.title: Data Collection
collection.subtitle: What data do we collect?
collection.intro: When visiting this website, the server automatically stores information that your browser transmits. This includes:

items.referrer: Websites from which the user's system accessed our website

collection.footer: This data is used exclusively to ensure the operation and to improve the service. It is not merged with other data sources.

contact.title: Contact Form
contact.content1: If you send us inquiries via email or contact form, your information from the inquiry form including the contact data you provided will be stored for the purpose of processing the inquiry and in case of follow-up questions.
contact.content2: We do not share this data without your consent. Processing is based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR, if your inquiry is related to the fulfillment of a contract or is necessary for the implementation of pre-contractual measures.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.intro: You have the right at any time to free information about your stored personal data, its origin and recipients, and the purpose of data processing, as well as the right to correct or delete this data.
rights.subtitle: Your rights at a glance:

access.title: Right of access:
access.description: You can request information about your stored data

rectification.title: Right to rectification:
rectification.description: You can request the correction of inaccurate data

deletion.title: Right to deletion:
deletion.description: You can request the deletion of your data

restriction.title: Right to restriction of processing:
restriction.description: You can request the restriction of processing

objection.title: Right to object:
objection.description: You can object to the processing

portability.title: Right to data portability:
portability.description: You can receive your data in a structured format

rights.footer: For this and other questions on the subject of personal data, you can always contact us at the address given in the imprint.
